Overall, Female patients tend to have higher average bills ($25,032) compared to Male patients ($23,848). Patients with chronic diseases also show slightly higher average bills ($24,878) compared to those without ($24,036). The differences across all groups are relatively small, suggesting that while gender and chronic disease status influence billing, the impact is moderate rather than dramatic.
